rows.verdict_le10: Neither pure thriller nor pure melodrama (though it has its true complement of doomed lovers
rows.dek_lead: Neither pure thriller nor pure melodrama (though it has its true complement of doomed lovers, dead bodies, and a cruel sexual undertow), on an emotional level it most resembles the wonderful purple-pulp fiction of David Goo
